actions.action: Separate quotation text from attribution verification
actions.mechanism: Store speaker identity and verification separately; imported labels never establish verified attribution, and unknown remains a valid identity.
actions.implementation: Default imports to unverified. Require reviewer identity and an explicit audio-review action to verify each quoted speaker span.
actions.check: Import a confidently labeled segment and an unresolved speaker; neither may appear as a verified named quotation.
actions.risk: Overly broad verification could incorrectly cover adjacent speech.

actions.mechanism: Corrections add evidence-bearing revisions rather than overwrite imported text, speaker labels, timestamps, or previous reviewer decisions.
actions.implementation: Retain immutable imports. Append revisions containing segment IDs, changed fields, reviewer identity, reason, parent revision, and review time.
actions.check: Correct text, attribution, and timing twice; reconstruct the import and both revisions with their respective reviewers.
actions.risk: Interfaces must distinguish original content from the current interpretation.

actions.action: Update saved collections without erasing their history
actions.mechanism: Saved quotations reference stable quote records while retaining the exact revision originally saved and subsequent collection events.
actions.implementation: Store quote ID and saved revision. Resolve current corrections on display, show a change notice, and preserve historical views.
actions.check: Save one quote in two collections, then correct attribution; both show the correction while their original snapshots remain retrievable.
actions.risk: Cached collection views can temporarily display superseded attribution.

actions.action: Represent boundary-crossing quotes as ordered spans
actions.mechanism: A quotation contains ordered source spans, allowing separate speakers and audio intervals instead of inheriting one segment's attribution.
actions.implementation: Store segment IDs, text offsets, audio intervals, and attribution per span. Mark mixed or partially unresolved quotations explicitly.
actions.check: Select a quote crossing two segments with different speakers, one unknown; preserve both spans without assigning the entire quote one name.
actions.risk: Segment boundaries may still split a single speaker's sentence.

actions.action: Review attribution against adjustable audio intervals
actions.mechanism: Audio review exposes incorrect timestamps and speaker transitions without introducing a new transcription model or inferring automated certainty.
actions.implementation: Provide context playback, looping, and interval-handle adjustment. Record timing corrections as revisions; changed evidence intervals invalidate affected attribution verification.
actions.check: Seed an interval that misses the quoted sentence; adjust it, replay it, and confirm previous verification requires renewed review.
actions.risk: Poor recordings may leave attribution unresolved despite careful review.

actions.action: Enforce provenance in every quote export
actions.mechanism: The export service includes attribution status and audio provenance, preventing client formatting from silently removing uncertainty or source access.
actions.implementation: Export per-span speaker status, revision IDs, and resolvable audio links with start/end times. Reject verified-only exports containing unresolved or unverified spans.
actions.check: Export a boundary-crossing, unknown-speaker quote through every supported format; uncertainty remains explicit and each link opens its intended audio interval.
actions.risk: Audio permissions or retention changes can later break access.

actions.action: Make speaker search respect verification state
actions.mechanism: Speaker filters distinguish reviewed identity from imported claims, so search relevance cannot imply that attribution has been established.
actions.implementation: Index imported and reviewed speakers separately. Default person filters to verified matches; offer visibly labeled unverified matches and unresolved-speaker search.
actions.check: Correct an imported Alice label to Bob; after indexing completes, Alice's verified results exclude it and Bob's include the reviewed revision.
actions.risk: Index lag requires stale-result warnings and authoritative checks when saving.

actions.action: Expose conflicting reviews instead of silently choosing
actions.mechanism: Concurrent incompatible corrections produce a disputed attribution state rather than letting the latest write appear definitively verified.
actions.implementation: Require parent revision IDs on review submissions. Retain competing revisions, flag affected quotes, and require explicit reviewer resolution before restoring verified attribution.
actions.check: Submit different speaker corrections from two reviewers against one revision; retain both identities and show disputed status in collections and exports.
actions.risk: Resolution queues can delay otherwise usable quotations.
